The most recently merged pull request in firecrawl/cli is **#319: "revert: documentation research and workflow setup (#318)"**. It was merged on Oct 16, 2026, about 6 hours before I checked.

The list I read was sorted by last update, not by merge time. #318 ("feat(skills): improve documentation research and workflow setup") was also merged about 6 hours ago. #319 reverts #318, so it must have been merged after it. I didn't compare the exact merge timestamps.

I got this by scraping GitHub's merged-PR list with the Firecrawl CLI, because `gh` wasn't authenticated and the direct API and page fetches were blocked.
